verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs list authenticator-app (TOTP) and backup codes as second-factor strategies, and sign-in returns needs_second_factor when MFA is enabled. A changelog entry on customizing the reverification window shows step-up re-authentication before sensitive actions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that MFA enrollment can be made mandatory for all users, in-depth docs on the step-up/reverification enforcement API (only a changelog line), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
